name: Observation Haki
description: Kenbunshoku: the sense of others' presence, intent and, for a rare few, the future.

stages.name: Sense presence
stages.description: Feel where living things are without seeing them.
stages.text: You knew someone was behind you before you turned.

stages.name: Wider range
stages.description: Sense people across a whole village.
stages.text: You could feel the whole harbour breathing around you.

stages.name: Read emotion and intent
stages.description: Hear what people feel, and what they mean to do.
stages.text: Anger, fear, a lie: you felt them as plainly as heat.

stages.name: Track through walls and crowds
stages.description: Follow one voice through a city.
stages.text: You followed a single heartbeat through a crowd of thousands.

stages.name: Future Sight
stages.description: See an attack before it starts.
stages.text: For a moment you saw what was going to happen, and stepped out of its way.

stages.name: The Voice of All Things
stages.description: Hear the voices of everything that lives: the sea, the ships, the beasts.
stages.text: You heard the ship you stood on speak, and the sea answer it.

teachers.name: Silvers Rayleigh, if he is willing
